# Vendored UI Runtime Notice

This directory vendors the offline browser assets (`rtr-ui.css`, `rtr-ui.iife.js`, and `html_inline.py`) from the sibling Read the Research UI Kit (`@zhouyang/rtr-ui-kit` v1.0.0) so `研究管理/看板/build_dashboard.py` runs as a self-contained pure Python 3.12 standard-library generator with zero Node/npm build dependencies.
